meta.description: AI citation readiness audit ONLY (does not touch Google rankings, use blog-rewrite for combined Google+AI work). Use whenever the user wants their content to rank in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews. AI citation optimization audit scoring blog posts for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview citability. Evaluates passage-level citability, Q&A formatting, entity clarity, structured data, and AI crawler accessibility. Generates citation capsules and a 0-100 AI Citation Readiness score. Use when user says "geo", "ai citation", "ai optimization", "citation audit", "aeo", "perplexity optimization", "chatgpt citation".
